summary: Over twelve years of experience providing high‑quality consulting and technical assistance to home and business end users. Field service technician since late 2004, skilled in installing, repairing, and maintaining POS equipment, servers, networking, and related peripherals. Integrates computer skills, customer support, and education to exceed technical, business, and customer expectations. Passionate about electronics demonstrations, direct sales, and training sessions. Professionally certified by CompTIA, Lexmark, Hewlett Packard, Microsoft, Fujitsu, IC³, ETA, FEMA, and other bodies.

education.degree: Undergraduate Certificate in Computer Information Management

experience.title: Information Technology Specialist
responsibilities: Service and maintain servers, workstations, laptops, and peripherals for clients.
Install and maintain CCTV‑DVR, VoIP, BDR data recovery, and cloud backup solutions (StorageCraft, Datto, VEEAM, Intronis).
Conduct business assessments (DLP, network audits, FINRA/HIPAA/PCI compliance).
Support over 480 Windows devices and 44 Windows/VMware servers.

experience.title: IT Systems Administrator
responsibilities: Maintain 55 Windows workstations, Dell Precision server, and IBM xSeries Blade server.
Troubleshoot telephony/VOIP/POTS, T1, and network issues; provide end‑user assistance and training.
Manage Windows Server 2003 with Active Directory.
Maintain AutoBase CRM, WiFi network, and printer fleet.
Coordinate purchase, installation, and training of new technology.

experience.title: Field Service Technician II
responsibilities: Field service on IBM servers, desktops, and POS systems; repair Lexmark printers and other hardware brands.
Install and troubleshoot networking equipment (patch panels, Ethernet, VoIP).
Perform break‑fix tasks, vehicle maintenance, RMA returns, and 24/7 on‑call support.
Act as senior technician, training new field staff.

experience.title: Kodak Imaging Expert / Field Marketing Specialist
responsibilities: Engage and train sales associates on product features and sales techniques.
Organize training events, presentations, and role‑playing sessions.
Increase brand awareness through merchandising and direct sales events.

experience.title: Merchandising / Marketing Specialist
responsibilities: Execute in‑store marketing and merchandising for technical hardware.
Set up plan‑o‑grams, security protocols, and manage shipments.
Self‑manage vehicle and coordinate security for displays.

experience.title: Digital Imaging Specialist
responsibilities: Retail sales of digital cameras; train customers on product use and features.
Conduct product demonstrations and manage Black Friday sales events.

experience.title: Business Machines Sales Associate
responsibilities: Retail sales of business machines and related peripherals.
Repair and troubleshoot personal computers; manage inventory and product displays.
